observations: Vegeta remains rear-facing in blue suit and brown-shoulder armor, driving both fists into Dodoria. Dodoria retains the wide-eyed strained face, pink spikes, two open hands and dark armor; green vertical speed lines and original width-relative framing retained.

Nail remains rear-facing at left in torn dark clothing and blue sash, facing small armored Frieza with folded arms on the right cliff. Blue Namek trees, rocky terraces and yellow/green sky retained. Frieza is too small in the original to resolve exact mouth or pupil shapes.

Nail retains the forward crouch, clenched fists, damaged dark tunic, pink arm panels and blue sash against blue ground and yellow path. Angry brows and visible clenched teeth remain; no additional zoom.

Frieza remains the extreme left close-up with red scouter and raised-corner toothy smile, with Nail’s foreshortened green arm behind. Original edge crop, segmented ear detail and black/white armor contours retained.

Nail retains both forearms crossed directly below his narrowed eyes, with the hands meeting opposite shoulders. Pink forearm bands, red cuffs, white shoulder fragments and green/yellow sky remain; mouth is occluded.

Goku remains flying horizontally beneath Burter’s blue forearm and brown armor, with both fists forward, orange gi, blue undershirt/wristbands and back insignia. Wide eyes and green speed-line sky retained. Exact tiny original mouth shape is unresolved.

Burter remains folded forward over Goku’s upward stomach punch; brown shoulder armor, blue limbs, Goku’s orange suit and the wide Namek shoreline retained. Original faces are too small/occluded for precise expression claims.

Trunks retains lavender spiked hair, blue jacket, black shirt, sword strap/sheath and both fists clenched at his sides. Stern eyes/closed mouth and blue background with pale aura retained. Original hair color preserved rather than substituting generic blond.

The two opposing fighters and the broad diagonal pink/white energy burst retain their positions on the tilted tiled platform. Original limbs and clothing silhouettes, dark blue background and left smoke plume remain; fine facial details are obscured by the blast.

Piccolo/Nail’s lateral rush into the black-haired opponent retains both torsos and bent legs, dark tunic, pink arm panels, blue sash and brown boots. Blue sky/white ground and speed-line direction remain. Facial contact is partly occluded in the original.

Goku and Gohan retain the midair sparring pose: Gohan’s extended punch, Goku’s raised defensive hand and bent knee, orange and purple clothing, and red/purple cloud background. Open intent eyes and clenched-mouth effort retained.

Krillin remains an extreme close-up with tightly shut eye, gritted teeth, several separate sweat drops and red/pink lighting. The original foreshortened shoulder/arm composition and pale horizontal background lines remain; sweat is not converted to lightning.

Gohan retains the flying kick with large near boot sole, tucked other leg, clenched fists, red wristbands and purple outfit. Angry eyes and teeth remain. Green valley, water and pale cloud bands retain their layout.

Super Saiyan Goku retains his extended finger beneath Trunks’s blade, focused green eyes and closed mouth, blond hair, Yardrat collar, yellow wristband and dark/white costume. Original yellow aura and blue field remain.

Trunks retains the raised sword arm and open foreshortened near hand, blond hair, blue jacket, sword strap and stern profile. Yellow rocky terrain and original elevated camera angle retained; the small original mouth line is not sufficiently clear for exact matching.

Rear-view blond Trunks remains beneath King Cold’s raised sword arm, with back scabbard, blue jacket and yellow aura. Cold’s gritted teeth, purple skin, horned helmet, black/red cape and armor remain. No new crop or added limb.

Chi-Chi retains her low fighting stance, one clenched fist and one extended hand, high bun, orange scarf and dark dress. Red vertical aura, beach, ocean horizon and blue clouded sky remain. Tiny original pupil/tooth details are unresolved.

The tilted red gravity-machine panel retains the 400G display, surrounding grille, buttons and housing. The retained decorative artwork includes its original display lettering; native card title/rules/footer remain separate vector outlines.

Gohan shields the bent green Namekian inside the yellow energy dome; their dark/purple clothes, clenched effort, debris and diagonal ground remain. Both visible arms are traced to their owners. Fine features on the bowed face remain obscured.

Approved exception: retain the current frontal Porunga, both completed open hands, red eyes, toothy mouth, black horns, green/tan body and green/teal clouds with yellow aura. Preserve full-card scale and colors. The old Krillin/Gohan scene and obsolete overhead Porunga are excluded. Category orb is one-star; footer rarity is independently one-star.

Spice and the shorter companion retain their relative heights and stance between the two columns, with white hair, green skin, magenta/black armor and yellow cape on Spice, and hat, yellow ruff, dark armor and purple pants on the companion. The original tiny mouth detail remains unresolved; no speculative expression edit.

Spice retains the upright low-angle stance with both fists, white hair, pointed ears, magenta/black armor, yellow scarf/cape and purple sky. Serious eyes remain. The original mouth is too small to distinguish a slight opening reliably.

All five characters retain the group formation: tall rear fighter, Spice at left, horned red-haired fighter at right, Garlic Jr. in front and short yellow-ruff companion. Distinct costumes and purple-black mist remain. Fine expressions of the small faces remain unresolved.

Piccolo remains centered in white cape and turban, facing the group whose backs/heads frame the foreground; the broad purple sky and dark ledge remain. White hair foreground and red-haired horned profile retain their crops. Tiny distant face details are unresolved.
Garlic Jr.’s hands retain the dark vessel and cover amid purple-black mist, with blue cuffs and pale green fingers. Original close framing and black/yellow garment details remain; no face is visible.

Garlic Jr. retains the torso arched backward, both arms raised outside the top crop, open shouting mouth with teeth/tongue and pink circular energy piercing the abdomen. Teal skin, dark pants and black background remain.

Garlic Jr. retains the extreme angled close-up, wide white eyes with small pupils, toothy sneer and muscular teal body alongside the yellow/white energy flare. The original dark negative space and strong foreshortening remain.

Bulma retains glowing white eyes, wide fanged mouth, teal hair, white collared shirt, red skirt and both raised clawing hands. Wooden floor, scattered debris and rope at upper left remain; the original possessed expression is preserved.

Krillin retains his downward head tilt, tightly clenched teeth, narrowed eyes, clenched fist/forearm and torn white undershirt. Original bald-head markings, muscular shoulder crop and pink speed background remain.
Krillin retains both eyes squeezed shut, clenched teeth, sweat, top fist and yellow impact flash at left. Close crop, head tilt and original warm shading remain; hands are not reassigned.

Mecha Frieza retains the forward-reaching hand and bright orb at left, open mouth, mechanical head/limb panels, segmented shoulders and curled rear hand. Blue diagonal speed lines and torso angle remain.

King Cold retains the close three-quarter face, narrow red eyes and asymmetric closed smile, horned helmet, purple neck and right shoulder arc against blue sky. Original raised mouth corner remains in the retained art.

King Cold remains seated/backed against the yellow cliff with raised head and open mouth, horned helmet, black/red shoulder armor and cape fastener. Original diagonal camera/torso framing and sky wedge retained.
Goku retains wide rounded eyes, relaxed closed smile, black hair, Yardrat neck ruff and shoulder strap against blue sky. Original close-up scale and white/dark costume retained.

Tien retains the existing tighter portrait crop: three eyes, stern brows, closed mouth and crossed muscular arms, white tank with torn shoulder edge, green wrist cloth and blue sky. The retained source already contains the corrected crop; no further zoom.

Burter and Jeice retain their forehead-to-forehead face-off, clenched teeth, blue/red skin, Jeice’s white hair and green scouter, brown shoulder armor and green sky. The scouter is visible in the original and is retained only where present.

Krillin retains the raised clenched fist, sideways gaze, broad clenched-teeth grimace, orange gi and blue wristband against green/yellow sky. Original foreshortened shoulder and close-up scale retained.

Jeice retains his forward flying lunge, near fist, windswept white hair, green scouter and white/brown armor. Distant tilted structure and colorful horizon remain. Exact small original pupil/mouth-corner geometry is unresolved.

Chiaotzu retains the upward gaze, angled brows, red cheek circles, black cap with red top, green vest, white sleeves, red sash and clenched hands on rocky ground. The small original mouth is insufficient to resolve its precise aperture; current art is retained.

Goku and Frieza retain the close grappling head strike, gripping hands/forearms, blond hair, white/purple body surfaces and extensive battle scratches. Both strained open mouths and teeth remain; no repaired clothing or invented limbs.

Frieza retains the two-arm hold around Goku from behind. Goku’s open shouting mouth, blond hair and torn orange/blue gi, Frieza’s narrowed expression and white/purple scratched body, and diagonal brown rock backdrop remain.

Frieza’s foreshortened palm remains driven into Goku’s torso; fingers, white forearm, purple panel, speed lines and tattered orange/blue cloth remain. The original extreme limb-only crop is preserved.

Dodoria retains the distant frontal dive, both hands spread wide, open shouting mouth, pink spikes and shoulder armor against radial green/yellow lines over Namek terrain. Exact tiny pupil/teeth details remain unresolved.

Frieza retains the bowed close-up, narrowed red eyes, gritted teeth, large purple head/shoulder plates and battle scratches beneath red vertical energy lines. Original symmetrical tension and crop remain.

Goku and Frieza retain the midair knee strike and near forearm contact, with Goku’s raised knee, torn orange pants and blond hair, Frieza’s white/purple limbs and trailing tail, and dark sky over green terrain. Tiny far eye details are unresolved.

Frieza retains the large foreshortened open near hand, smaller clenched rear hand, twisted torso and raised-corner toothy expression. Dark blue diagonal speed lines and all five near fingers remain. No scouter is added.

Piccolo retains the turban, white cape/scarf, sideways stern gaze and the previously approved small open-mouth patch with white inner/teeth detail. Patch is reapplied at its recorded native position through the common art mapping; underlying artwork bytes remain intact.
Captain Ginyu retains the open shouting mouth, upper/lower teeth, furrowed head, green scouter, horned head and both raised hands. Brown/white armor and green/yellow sky remain.

Captain Ginyu retains his near palm beneath the bright white/yellow orb, broad toothy grin, green scouter, horned head and brown/black/white armor against purple/pink vertical energy. The orb’s intentional occlusion remains.

Nail retains his forward stance and clenched fists, stern narrowed eyes, closed mouth, damaged dark tunic, pink body/arm panels and blue sash. Blue water/grass, yellow-green sky and original full-width subject scale remain.
